text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health (TPH) Capital Budget Variance for the nine months ended on September 30, 2019. As of September 30, 2019, TPH spent $2.633 million, representing 54.1 percent of the 2019 Approved Capital Budget of $4.864 million.
The Board of Health received the report (October 24, 2019) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
